summary: R6.4 Production Module Frontend E2E Testing Complete - All critical flows verified for Admin, Manager, and Warehouse roles. Navigation accordion behavior confirmed, WO lifecycle (CREATE/RELEASE/COMPLETE) working, BOM validation working, RBAC permissions correct, no stability issues.

backend_issues.notes: Backend testing SKIPPED as instructed - already 35/35 PASS in iteration 157

passed_tests: Navigation: Admin can access Production module via accordion (open Gudang group → click Produksi)
Navigation: Accordion behavior verified - nav-production only visible after opening Gudang group
KPI: All 4 KPIs displayed correctly (Total BOM: 3, WO Terbuka: 2-3, WO Selesai: 2-3, Nilai Produksi: Rp 2.6-3.5 jt)
Tabs: WO ↔ BOM tab switching works correctly
WO CREATE: Successfully created new WO with form validation
WO Plan Preview: Live material plan displayed with qty and availability
WO Plan Preview: Badge changes reactively (Bahan mencukupi → Bahan kurang when qty increased to 99999)
WO RELEASE: Draft WO successfully released to Dirilis status
WO COMPLETE: Released WO successfully completed to Selesai status with HPP calculation
WO DETAIL: Detail panel displays consumed materials (wo-detail-mat-0)
WO DETAIL: HPP breakdown displayed (Biaya bahan, Overhead, Total HPP, HPP/unit)
BOM Validation: Empty name rejected with error message 'Nama BOM wajib diisi'
BOM Validation: No components rejected with error message 'Minimal satu komponen'
BOM Validation: Component == Output rejected with error message 'Bahan tidak boleh sama dengan output'
BOM Validation: Qty = 0 rejected with error message 'qty per unit harus > 0'
RBAC Manager: Can access Production module
RBAC Manager: Has manage_bom permission (Tambah BOM button visible on BOM tab)
RBAC Manager: Can create Work Order (Buat Work Order button visible)
RBAC Warehouse: Can access Production module
RBAC Warehouse: Can create Work Order (Buat Work Order button visible)
RBAC Warehouse: Does NOT have manage_bom (Tambah BOM button NOT visible - correct)
Stability: No React crashes or white screen errors
Stability: No console errors detected
UI Language: All UI elements in Bahasa Indonesia

additional_notes.iteration_context: Iteration 158 focused on comprehensive frontend E2E testing for Production module as Admin, Manager, and Warehouse roles. Backend was SKIPPED as it already passed 35/35 tests in iteration 157.
additional_notes.navigation_clarification: The 'admin cannot access Production menu' issue from iteration 157 was confirmed to be NOT A BUG - it's the accordion IA design where all groups are collapsed after login. Users must click the Gudang group toggle first to reveal the Produksi menu item. This behavior is consistent across all roles and all menu groups.
additional_notes.test_coverage: Tested: Navigation (accordion), KPI display, Tab switching, WO CREATE with live plan preview, WO RELEASE, WO COMPLETE with HPP, WO DETAIL panel, BOM frontend validation (4 cases), RBAC for admin/manager/warehouse roles, Stability (no crashes/errors).
additional_notes.demo_data_state: After testing: 3 BOMs (including TEST BOM Sortir Lurik created during test), 7 WOs total (WO-00007 created and completed during test with HPP Rp 878.750), KPIs showing correct aggregated values.
additional_notes.rbac_verification: Manager: Has manage_bom (Tambah BOM visible on BOM tab), can create WO. Warehouse: Can create WO, CANNOT see Tambah BOM (correct - no manage_bom permission). All RBAC rules working as expected.
additional_notes.stability: No React errors, no console errors, no white screen, no crashes. All UI elements rendering correctly in Bahasa Indonesia.
additional_notes.screenshots_evidence: 4 screenshots captured showing: (1) Manager with Tambah BOM button on BOM tab, (2) Admin WO actions with completed WO-00007 showing HPP, (3) Final KPI view with updated values, (4) Final BOM tab with 3 BOMs.
additional_notes.not_fully_tested: BOM EDIT/DELETE flows were not fully tested end-to-end (validation tested but not complete CRUD). WO CANCEL and WO status filter were attempted but not fully verified due to element detachment issues in test automation. These are minor flows and the core functionality is verified.
additional_notes.frontend_bundle: Frontend served from static build (/app/frontend/build via static_server.js). No hot reload. Bundle was already rebuilt before this test session by main agent.
